title: Construct complementary B/C cancellation and prove a serial-consumer cost ceiling (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

An exact typed complementary B/C consumer works, but its complete recursive bill loses. A stronger written bound excludes every positive saving for the declared serial fixed-owner model. This is a scoped construction and ceiling contribution; no new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

On the 56 matched exceptional pairs, execute C1, then B2, then Y-=2X, with a shared central Q and disjoint seven-axis blocks D1,D2:

```text
L(-2) B2 C1 = diag(D2 D1 Q, D2 D1 Q).
```

The other 56 ordinary pairs require L(-2 Q^-1), hence 56 paid rank-one query children. Replacing that correction with a scalar shear is false. All 1,040 independent persistent inputs are retained: 224 main fields and two disjoint banks of 408 helpers. Main targets are 112 rank-14 and 112 rank-15 jobs. Every inherited helper is credited once. Complete paid rank mass is 9,579 versus target mass 9,403: deficit 176.

This specifies exact typed endpoints and actual gatewise raw inverse transpose under the audited supplier/owned-temporary interfaces. It does not freshly emit or phase-check a complete 1,040-field native trace. Physical witness, positive caller moment and funded compiler/outer transfer remain separate milestones.

For n>=2 whole calls on the same 224 main owners, one shared Q and n disjoint seven-axis blocks, with only the source helpers as additional productive fields and main target ranks at most 7n+1, the optimistic target-minus-paid moment satisfies:

```text
t=1-C, 0<C<1, n_B+n_C=n
M(C) <= 224*(7n+1)^t - n*(224*7^t+112) - 8*n_B*7^(-C) < 0.
```

Cleanup and finite work are granted free only for this rejection bound. At C=0 the upper bound is 224-112n-8n_B; two C calls only tie zero. The all-exponent proof normalizes the refreshed B/C direct-price gap and checks derivative bounds 1795/7 and 1857/7, then uses strict subadditivity. It is not an extrapolation from a tested point. Changed ownership, interleaved extra productive jobs, shared producer work or different geometry lie outside this ceiling.

## Validation

Python 3.12.3, Linux, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/complementary-consumer-feasibility/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complementary-consumer-feasibility
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/complementary-consumer-feasibility --check-source-history
```

Registered replay, exact committed-byte/source-history preflight and a Git-free optimized export with PATH=/nonexistent pass. Actual source-byte and type-sensitive receipt corruptions reject. Mathematical controls reject the wrong exceptional coefficient, omitted ordinary Q^-1 correction and forward word substituted for raw dual.

A second agent independently rederived the derivative and universal-n proof, counted the paid/target profiles without importing this verifier, and checked a separate exact rational 2x2 fixture with non-involutive Q=-2/3. It confirmed the raw-dual order and rejected the ordinary scalar-only correction. Parent also read the proof/checker, recomputed the pair identity and reran optimized verification. These are automated/agent checks, not independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Not freshly run: the retained native phase suite, full physical caller, finite precision, fixed-tape compiler, Lean, outer admission or selected scientific cold replay. The [initial hosted run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39860907480) failed before package replay because detached Git maintenance raced temporary sparse-fixture cleanup. [Repair #4857](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4857) is included additively; [run 39863812767](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39863812767) completed successfully at exact additive head: all 347 helper tests pass (11 expected skips), this scientific package replays successfully, and its committed-input mutation gate passes. Local exact-head registered replay and source-history checks pass. Scalar, movement, storage and precision bills remain separate finite obligations.

## Open next questions

See PROOF.md, README.md and TASK.json. Stop enlarging this serial consumer family. A useful successor must change ownership/incidence, share actual producer work, or improve the native paid profile enough to restore a discount. Begin with one actual cross-contact word and disjoint target census, then a favourable optimistic complete bill before implementation. [Canonical result #4853](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4853) and the required [handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19133514) record the scope and next task.
